info.title: QuilrAI Docs Index
info.description: Read-only, static index of the QuilrAI documentation, generated at build time by plugins/llms-txt.js and served by GitHub Pages. Quilr Assist uses it to pick the right docs page (by console route, aliases, title or section), then fetches that page's markdown from the page's `markdown` URL (the page URL plus `.md`; a plain-text twin is at `.txt`). Covers the current (V2) console and every product; Console V1 (legacy) pages are not included. Responses carry an `ETag`, so clients can revalidate with `If-None-Match` and get `304 Not Modified` when nothing changed. Keep this file in step with the index shape in plugins/llms-txt.js.

get.summary: Every docs page and product video, grouped by product and sidebar group

304.description: Not modified since the ETag sent in If-None-Match.

404.description: Not found (for example a future version path that is not published yet).

generatedAt.description: Build time. Changes on every build, including daily rebuilds of unchanged docs.

contentHash.description: Hash of products and videos. Changes only when the content changes; use it to invalidate cached pages.

products.description: Keyed by product id: console, llm, mcp, agents, red, browser, endpoint, integ (src/data/products.js). Key order is sidebar order.

consoleGuide.description: Plain-text navigation guide for the product's console pages, when one exists.

groups.description: Keyed by sidebar group folder (for example get-started, protect). Key order is sidebar order.

title.description: Sidebar label, else the page title.

description.description: Frontmatter description, else the first paragraph.

markdown.description: The page as markdown (text/markdown). Swap .md for .txt to get text/plain.

consolePaths.description: Admin console routes this page documents (quilr-console frontend/src/lib/appPaths.ts). Absent when the page maps to no single screen.

aliases.description: Words admins use for what this page covers. Absent when none are set.

videos.description: Ids of videos (see Index.videos) that cover this page.

kind.description: explainer: illustrated concept. walkthrough: recorded in the console, so it can go stale when the UI changes.

embed.description: Privacy-enhanced (youtube-nocookie.com) player URL. Load it only after the user clicks; append autoplay=1 then.

questions.description: Questions an admin might ask that this video answers.

pages.description: Docs pages that cover the same feature.
